source: RFC 8725 §2.1, §3.2; ADR 0007; ADR 0027 §6; conformance/tools/jwt-oracle (node:crypto, Node v24.21.0, OpenSSL 3.5.8)
description: An alg none token carrying a forged signature: the HMAC-SHA256 of its own signing input under the caller's HS256 key (computed with Python's hmac), so a verifier that ignored alg none and used the key's family would accept it. alg none is never accepted: AlgorithmNotAllowed
